Offline coordinate resources for documentation
==============================================

2beg.pdb.gz is an unchanged RCSB PDB download. Its adjacent provenance record
contains the exact URL, retrieval date, compressed/decompressed hashes and
counts. The file retains all ten deposited structures; the geometry lesson
selects structure index 0 explicitly. PDB authors, numbering, coordinate units
(angstrom) and metadata remain in the original file.

Entry: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/2BEG
Entry DOI: https://doi.org/10.2210/pdb2BEG/pdb
Original study: Luehrs et al. (2005), PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.0506723102.

The separate KLVFF model and its translation in the lesson are illustrative
MolSysMT construction operations, not part of the deposited structure or an
experimentally established complex. No preparation or affinity claim follows.
